science.title: Built from high-density human performance data.
science.body: Thalos is developed around a 26-week real-world performance study with strength athletes in Vienna. The goal is simple: understand how training, nutrition, recovery and biomarkers interact over time — and translate that complexity into better coaching. The data layer includes workout logs, nutrition tracking, wearable signals, glucose data, lactate measurements, blood panels, microbiome analysis, body composition and performance testing. This is science made usable. Not a dashboard. Not a generic fitness app. A performance system.
science.disclaimer: Thalos is a performance and fitness coaching platform. It does not provide medical diagnoses or therapy recommendations.

youAreUnique.title: You are unique. Train unique.
youAreUnique.body: Generic plans create generic results. Your body does not adapt like everyone else's. Your sleep is different. Your recovery is different. Your nutrition is different. Your stress is different. Your response to training is different. Thalos builds around that difference. The longer you train with Thalos, the sharper your performance profile becomes — and the more precisely your coach can adapt.

device.title: More signal. More context. Better analytics.
device.polar: The Polar360 device is included in the Founding Athlete price. It provides continuous baseline data — similar to Polar Loop — and makes your performance profile denser.
device.polarTerms: If you cancel within the first 12 months, you return the device or keep it and pay the prorated remaining amount.
device.cgm: CGM data should currently be integrated through Apple Health. In the study, we use Dexcom G7. Dexcom G7 is available through Thalos.
device.lactate: Lactate measurements are optional, but valuable — especially if you want to understand training intensity more precisely. In the study, we use the EKF Lactate Scout Sport. Loan devices are available through Thalos.
